name: Cobra Venom
source:
Max, a special operator, pursues an arch enemy that killed his partner and best friend, Tony. The mysterious and powerful terrorist Cobra has infiltrated the criminal underworld as well as law enforcement agencies, continuing to obstruct Max's attempts achieve justice for his friend.

Max promised his dying friend that he would protect his family, which is no easy task. Tony's widow and our protagonist have a complicated past, and Tony's daughter believes Max is responsible for her father's top secret demise.

[From [url=https://sava007.itch.io/cobra-venom]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
特战队员麦克斯正在追捕杀害搭档兼挚友托尼的宿敌。神秘而强大的恐怖分子“眼镜蛇”，不仅渗透了地下犯罪世界，也将势力伸进执法机构，不断阻挠麦克斯为朋友讨回公道。

麦克斯曾向临终的朋友承诺，会保护他的家人，可这绝非易事。托尼的遗孀与主人公有着复杂的过去，而托尼的女儿，则认为麦克斯应为父亲那场被高度保密的死亡负责。

[摘自[url=https://sava007.itch.io/cobra-venom]Itch.io[/url]]
